title: Halftone
description: With the Beatles printed as a live halftone in one black ink on warm paper, with a line set in the same dot screen below it. The screen angle, dot size and dot shape (round, line, cross) drift on their own while the print breathes into the clean picture; drag across it and the dots are pushed aside like iron near a magnet, then spring back.
intent: The feeling of print without a fake page: one fragment shader screens the cover and the line together, each dot is a rigid cell that keeps its tone when a spring field under the pointer moves it, and the covers change through the dots at the coarsest point of each breath.
sources: herb reference board: 039a magazine cut-out (halftoned sky photo)
